thag4.10:1.1:
The Dhamma protects
those who live by the Dhamma.
thag4.10:1.3:
This—the reward
when the Dhamma’s well-practiced:
thag4.10:1.4:
One who lives by the Dhamma
doesn’t go to a bad destination.
thag4.10:3.1:
So you should engender desire
for acts of Dhamma,
thag4.10:3.2:
rejoicing
in the One Well-Gone,
the one who is Such.
thag4.10:3.3:
Standing firm in the Dhamma,
of the foremost
One Well-Gone,
his disciples
thag4.10:3.4:
are guided
—enlightened—
to the foremost
refuge supreme.
thag4.10:4.1: Burst is the root of the boil;
thag4.10:4.3:
He, having ended his wandering-on,
has no stain—
thag4.10:4.4:
like the moon
on a clear full-moon night.
